items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lee Morgan didn‘t live long. Lee was good, he would have been here. He would have, people don‘t know how good Lee was going to be.

ctx.x: Les Hite was a good band, man. When I came out, quit Jimmie Lunceford, and finally Gerald, we both quit the same year in ‘42. Gerald came to California, Lester Young and Lee Young formed a band and they knew I was in Dayton so they wanted

Snooky Young in that Young band. I came to California to join Lee and Lester Young‘s band and somehow I didn‘t want to play in a small band. I swear to God, I didn‘t want to play in a small band and I joined Floyd, I mean…
